inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Franchise Tax Delinquent: The operations franchise tax is delinquent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Franchise Tax Delinquent (26 TAC §745.247)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The operation has not submitted an application for a fire inspection. The fire inspection expired on 5/22/26.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The permit holder failed to ensure that the annual inspection was completed timely.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The operation does not have a current fire inspection. The fire inspection expired on 5/22/26.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: During the walk through a caregiver provided the incorrect number of children they were responsible for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: During the walk through the toddler classroom did not have an evacuation and relocation diagram posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the walk through CCR staff observed two toilets clogged and operation staff was not aware of how long the toilets have been clogged.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: CCR staff observed the television on and asked operation staff did the lesson plan for the day go along with the show the children were watching. The caregiver stated no and turned the television off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: During the walk through CCR staff observed two infant in highchairs without safety staps fastened. This was corrected when the caregiver fastened the straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: When CCR staff arrived to the operation the 3-4 year old classroom was out of ratio. One caregiver was caring for 19 children SAG 4 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: During the walk through a caregiver provided incorrect ages of children in their class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During the walkthrough there was two classrooms with children under two with the television on.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: During the walkthrough a caregiver provided the incorrect number of children they were responsible for twice when asked. When CCR staff counted the children neither of number of children provided by the caregiver was correct.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the walkthrough one caregiver was caring for 19 children SAG 2 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the investigation incitation inspection operation staff confirmed a staff member was allowed to work at the operation without a cleared background check. The background check was submitted but their fingerprints had not been completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Based on the information obtained throughout the investigation, if was found that the director did not make sure the operation was operating in compliance with minimum standards daily as the daycare has been found to be out of ratio and caregivers have been allowed to work without background checks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: There was one caregiver present at the operation with an inactive background check. This was corrected when the caregiver left the operation and the director ran her background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Infant's Mood: The daily report did not include the infants mood during the inspection;.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Infant's Mood (26 TAC §746.2431(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Infant feeding instructions were not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Bottles/cups were observed in the infant class unlabeled. This was corrected when the caregiver labeled the bottles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: Cribs were not labeled for the children present in the classroom. This was corrected when the operation made labels and posted them on the wall above the cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: An infant was observed in a bouncer without safety straps fastened. This was corrected when the child was removed from the bouncer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Times of Diaper Changes: The daily report did not include times of diaper changes during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Times of Diaper Changes (26 TAC §746.2431(3))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Times Slept: The daily report did not include the nap times during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Times Slept (26 TAC §746.2431(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Summary of Activities: The daily reports did not include a summary of activities during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Summary of Activities (26 TAC §746.2431(5))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: An infant was observed asleep in a swing. The caregiver corrected this by removing the child from the swing and placed the child in a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests: One out of four employee files reviewed did not contain documentation CPR/First Aid training had been completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests (26 TAC §746.1329(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner: There were soiled diapers observed to be loose in an open trash can in one of the classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3505(f))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: One sink was observed to be utilized for both handwashing and preparation of bottles in the infant classroom. The caregiver corrected this by removing bottles away from the handwashing sink and diapering area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: One of two vans used to transport youth in care did not contain a fire extinguisher or first aid kit. The director corrected this by placing a first aid kit and fire extinguisher in the van.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: Two vans used to transport children did not have an electronic child safety alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: During the investigation, three children disclosed that a "whoppin" was used as a discipline method at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children: In the two-year-old to three-year-old classroom, cough medicine was found on the desk and accessible to children. Note: This was corrected when staff removed the medication and placed out of reach from the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3807(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: During the walk through, two children aged four and age five in the toddler classroom were sitting in highchairs from 9:39am to 10:06am. In addition, a four-year-old was observed in a restrictive device for time out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: During the follow up inspection, one child did not have immunizations on file and one child did not have updated immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the inspection I observed 12 children to be present in the infant room. Based on the specified age group, the room exceeded the maximum group size of 10.     NOTE: During the insepction, two children were moved to another classroom to maintain ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: I evaluated 10 childrens records and the following was observed:     - One child did not have an emergency care authorization  - One child did not have a phone number or address for the emergency contact.   - One child did not have record of immunizations  - One child did not have an up to date record of immunizations
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The operation did not have an up to date fire inspection. The most recent fire inspection was completed on 9/13/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver with a pending background check was observed to be present in the classroom and caring for children.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver left the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children: In the toddler class, cough medicine was found in an accessible  small storage bin drawer. The cough medicine was in the 3rd drawer from the bottom which is reachable for the toddler children.   This was corrected when the director removed the medicine from the drawer and placing it in the office.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3807(1))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: One toddler classroom did not have the nap chart showing which cot belonged which child.     Note: This was corrected when the nap chart was made.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: One infant was observed sleeping in the crib with pacifier cord attached.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One out of ten child records reviewed is missing the immunization record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver present in the infant room did not have valid background checks. The background check is inactive.     Note: Caregvier was asked to leave.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: During the walkthrough one toddler room did not have the fire exit diagram posted.     Note: This was corrected at iinspection when it was posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits: It was observed that in the toddler room a cot being used by a toddler was blocking the exit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits (26 TAC §746.2909(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: One infant was observed asleep in a restrictive device (Bouncer).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: Three infants were observed sleeping in the crib with blankets, bottles and bibs.     5 month old had a bib on and bottle inside the crib.   10 month old had a blanket inside the crib   10 month old had a bottle inside the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Eight  out of ten caregivers files reviewed is missing the educations qualifications on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: The fire drills for september was not documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One out of ten child records reviewed is missing the health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: A classroom with 19 children in care ages 3-4yrs old was observed napping without an adult supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: 5 month Infant was observed sleeping in crib with a pacifier attachment and bib around her neck.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: During investigation Director was not aware of child with a medical statement declaring a child food allergy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: During investigation food allergy plan for child enrolled with a food allergy could not be observed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Required Postings-Child's Food Allergies: During investigation a list of children in care with food allergies was not observed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Postings-Child's Food Allergies (26 TAC §746.401(10))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: 3 caregivers were observed caring for children with an active background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: During follow up 3 of the 6 caregivers folder did not have clock hour trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: 2 infants 12months and younger were observed sleeping with blankets, wipes and pampers in crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was observed in the Infant classroom  without an active background.    Corrected at inspection: caregiver was asked to  leave.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: Mulch was not observed on the outside play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)
